name: ExperienceEngine
description: Helps coding agents avoid repeating failed execution paths by learning from real task outcomes and governing when prior guidance should be reused.

dataDir.description: Base directory for ExperienceEngine runtime data.

sqlitePath.description: SQLite file path for ExperienceEngine metadata.

captureRawPayloads.description: Persist raw OpenClaw lifecycle payloads for local runtime validation.

captureDir.description: Directory used to store raw runtime payload captures.

distillerProvider.description: Provider used for semantic learning and provider-backed decision explanation.

distillerModel.description: Model used for semantic learning and provider-backed decision explanation.

maxHints.description: Maximum number of experience hints injected per turn.

hybridSyncExplainEnabled.description: Allow bounded sync escalation for explicit explanation requests.

hybridAsyncPostmortemEnabled.description: Allow bounded async postmortem review for eligible completed runs.

hybridAsyncPostmortemLlmEnabled.description: Enable provider-backed posttask review for eligible completed runs.

hybridExplainLlmEnabled.description: Enable provider-backed explanation for eligible intervention decisions.

hybridExplainProviderMode.description: Provider resolution mode for decision explanation.

hybridExplainModelProfileVersion.description: Version label for the provider-backed decision-explanation model profile.

hybridPostmortemProviderMode.description: Provider resolution mode for posttask review.

hybridPostmortemModelProfileVersion.description: Version label for the provider-backed posttask-review model profile.
